name: SpatialEval
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities of language and vision-language models, covering relationship understanding, navigation, and counting tasks. It reveals challenges in spatial reasoning and the interplay between textual and visual information in multimodal models.
reputation: A newer multimodal spatial reasoning benchmark that has seen some use in VLM evaluation, but it is not yet as established as long-running benchmarks.
notes: Highlights that spatial reasoning is challenging for current models and that multimodal models may under-utilize visual information when textual clues suffice.
